scenarios.prompt: A rider stands and walks on a translating platform, then jumps. Define platform-relative carry and departure velocity exactly once.

criteria.reference_frame: Publishes platform point motion and a single world/relative reference-frame conversion.
criteria.ownership: Moving-platform owns carry/transfer while locomotion, platform-jump and jump-leniency retain their domains.
criteria.evidence: Tests stand/walk/jump/reland plus reversed update order without double-applying platform velocity.
